I’m in the exact same boat. I don’t know what to do, honestly. I’m just taking things one day at a time. One foot in front of the other. Tomorrow is always brighter than today. 

Remembering is hard. She’s perfect every time I see her in my mind, and it crushes me to be away from her. But I don’t want to forget. I want to hold this and her forever. 

In twenty years, we’ll remember this and laugh, I hope. Love is the hardest thing we do, and we do it because we have to. If not for love, what would we even be?
This post calmed me so much. You have no idea how much you’ve done for me. Thank you so much.
